nodes.label: Post-Commit Auto-Rebuild Hook
nodes.rationale: Triggers once per commit with no background process: diffs HEAD~1 for changed code files, re-runs AST extraction on them, and rebuilds graph.json and GRAPH_REPORT.md. Doc and image changes are ignored and need a manual --update. An existing post-commit hook is appended to rather than replaced.

nodes.label: Native CLAUDE.md Integration
nodes.rationale: graphify claude install writes a ## graphify section into the local CLAUDE.md instructing the agent to check the graph before answering codebase questions and rebuild after code changes, making graphify always-on without a manual /graphify invocation.
